messages.author: bd837dec56edd1af
messages.subject: Informal Meetup Tuesday 28th June Evening
parts:
Hi, all,

Apologies for the short notice, but a few of us will be meeting up on
the evening of Tuesday 28th June for a casual get-to-know-each-other
sort of thing. Venue/exact time to be determined but probably a pub in
downtown Dublin where those who wish to can get food.

Don't worry if you can't make it, we'll probably be meeting up again
socially in late August and hopefully we will be starting to meet more
formally in September or October.

Please reply to this email with a +1 if you think you can make it on
Tuesday so I have approximate numbers, and of course if you know of
anyone who might be interested please ask them to join the group (or
just +2 on their behalf if that's easier).

messages.subject: Re: Informal Meetup Tuesday 28th June Evening
parts:
I've contacted a few other people who are interested in the R group,
but won't be able to make it along this evening, so it will probably
be just the 3 of us. (Anyone else reading this, feel free to pop
along.)

We'll meet at the MV Cill Arne (as Kevin pointed out it's the kill-R-
ney), which is the pub-boat just opposite the new Conference Centre on
the Liffey near NCI.

http://www.mvcillairne.com/

Walk along the North Quays towards the Point and it's hard to miss. Or
take the Red Luas to Mayor Square or Spencer Dock. My mobile is
0858063637. I'll be there from 6pm on.

-Ana
